mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, template_id, version_no, schema_version, schema_json, schema_hash, resource_manifest, publish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_print_template_version (tenant_id, template_id, version_no, schema_version, schema_json, schema_hash, resource_manifest, publish_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{templateId}, #{versionNo}, #{schemaVersion}, #{schemaJson}, #{schemaHash}, #{resourceManifest}, #{publishTime}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{createDept}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_print_template_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND id = #{id} AND del_flag = 0

SELECT id, tenant_id, template_id, version_no, schema_version, schema_hash, publish_time, create_by FROM sys_print_template_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId} AND del_flag = 0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM sys_print_template_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND template_id = #{templateId}
